paraphrase: There is a finite universally accessible model in which a power is transmitted from an intrinsically powered source to an effect, while that source exists contingently and another being directly supports its existence. There is another coherent model with the same power source and instrumental effect, in which the source exists in every accessible world without a recorded external supporter yet has a proper component. Thus original power in one respect by itself does not logically entail underived existence, necessity, or simplicity.
